# Data Model & Migrations

**Scope**: `back/app/models/` is the only schema definition; migrations are autogenerated from it and hand-reviewed. Any invariant expressible in the DB (unique, check, FK, partial index) goes there, not only in Python.
Not here → `zaolang-editor-drama` (Series/episode semantics, collaborators), `zaolang-blocking-studio` (白膜 tables), `zaolang-canvas` (canvas tables), `zaolang-creation-library` (CreationSkill), `zaolang-credits-billing` (ledger flows), `zaolang-generation-jobs` (job state machine use).

## Key Paths

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `back/app/models/base.py` | `Base`, `TimestampMixin`, `NAMING_CONVENTION`, `new_id(prefix)`, `id_column(prefix)` |
| `back/app/models/enums.py` | every enum + all status-transition tables (`*_TRANSITIONS`, `TERMINAL_*` sets) |
| `back/app/models/__init__.py` | re-exports every model (and `__all__`) so `Base.metadata` is complete for autogenerate |
| `back/app/models/` (modules) | one module per domain; table map in `reference-tables.md` |
| `back/alembic/versions/` | linear chain; find head with `cd back && conda run -n zaolang alembic heads` |
| `back/app/api/v1/admin/observability.py` | `GET /v1/admin/health` reports the DB's applied `alembic_revision` |
| `back/app/scripts/seed.py` | `RESET_TABLES` + `_reset` (`TRUNCATE … CASCADE`, then `DELETE FROM series WHERE kind = 'drama'`) |

## Invariants

1. IDs: `id: Mapped[str] = id_column("<prefix>")` → `f"{prefix}_{48-bit ms time + 80 random bits}"`, `String(40)`. Never autoincrement, bare UUID, or hand-written literals outside tests. Pick a prefix no other table uses (grep `id_column("` in `back/app/models`).
2. Money/credits are `Integer` in the smallest unit; `Numeric`/`Float` forbidden (canvas positions are ints too).
3. Constraint/index names follow `NAMING_CONVENTION` (or pass explicit `name=`), else autogenerate churns.
4. Ledger keys are untouchable: `uq_credit_ledger_job_type` `(job_id, type)`, `uq_credit_ledger_idempotency`, `uq_credit_ledger_payment` (`back/app/models/credits.py`). They are the real "capture once / post once" guarantees.
5. `JobEvent.sequence` is gapless from 1, unique `uq_job_events_job_sequence`; SSE resume depends on it.
6. Never `DELETE` a `Work`/`WorkVersion`/`LineageEdge`: tombstone via `LifecycleStatus.TOMBSTONE`. User deletion = anonymisation (`zaolang-compliance-audit`).
7. Enums persist as strings: adding a value is safe, renaming is a data migration. Stateful enums pair with a `<NAME>_TRANSITIONS` dict (and a terminal set) in `enums.py`; change both together. Each table is independent — adding a job status touches no other table.
8. `Draft.latest_job_id` = last submit (retry, notifications); `Draft.applied_job_id` = generation driving preview/publish (moves with `output_asset_id`). Never merge them. Hiding a version stamps `GenerationJob.draft_history_hidden_at`; never delete the job.
9. `Series` is one table (`kind`): only `drama` is created; there is no `/v1/series` route. Never add a second episode table. `SeriesCollaborator` is one row per `(series_id, user_id)` for life — details `zaolang-editor-drama`.
10. Characters/scenes/covers are `CreationSkill` rows (`IMAGE_ASSET_SKILL_CATEGORIES`), not tables. Character titles unique per owner via partial index `uq_creation_skills_owner_character_title` (`back/app/models/skill_library.py`).
11. JSON/JSONB: SQLAlchemy tracks by identity, so mutating a nested dict/list in place and reassigning it can skip the UPDATE silently. Accessors return copies (see `back/app/domain/characters/service.py`); tests must `session.expire_all()` before asserting.
12. Trace/association columns (`JobEvent.node_id`, `AgentRun.input_json`, `GenerationJob.promoted_from_job_id`, `SystemLog.job_id`, canvas `binding_*_id`) may be nullable, unbackfilled and FK-less — the target may be cleaned up first.
13. 白膜 additions: `EpisodeBlockingVersion` (`back/app/models/editor.py`), `DramaEpisode.blocking_json` / `target_duration_seconds`, `EpisodeScriptTurn.origin` (`script`/`blocking`) — see `zaolang-blocking-studio`.

## Recipes

**Add a table**
1. Class in the right `models/*.py`, `Base, TimestampMixin`, `id_column(...)`.
2. Export from `back/app/models/__init__.py` (+ `__all__`).
3. `make migration m="add xxx"` → review by hand (autogenerate misses CHECKs, partial indexes, `server_default`).
4. `make migrate`; `make reset` for a from-empty check.
5. Business table → add to `RESET_TABLES`, unless it is already truncated via an FK to a listed table (`TRUNCATE … CASCADE` clears every referencing table, e.g. canvas via `users`). Never put `series` itself in `RESET_TABLES`.

**Add a column**: nullable or `server_default` (e.g. `GenerationJob.origin` defaults `user`). NOT NULL = add nullable + backfill, then tighten in a second migration.

**Add an enum value**: additive; check `match` branches and frontend unions — generated types come via `make openapi`, but hand-kept lists exist (e.g. `SERIES_GENRES` in `front/src/features/drama-dashboard/format.ts` + i18n keys in all locales).

## Verify

```bash
make reset                      # empty DB → migrate → seed
make seed ARGS=--reset          # reseed without dropping volumes
cd back && conda run -n zaolang alembic upgrade head && conda run -n zaolang alembic check
make test-back
make openapi                    # commit back/openapi.json + front/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
```
